Thank you for bringing this to light. Please know that there are students at Purchase who stand with Davidson and want justice for him. We’re organizing an event on the campus for later today.
#JusticeforDavidson #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/59mdJle2sh

I submitted a monologue from my senior project BLK GRL to the 50in50: What Place Do We Have In This Movement? event at The Billie Holiday Theatre in Brooklyn & was accepted! This is a 90-min performance w/ works from 50 WOC about our place in the #MeToo movement. Come support! https://t.co/Eaf2BjzpkS
